opening.argument: The presentation explains a Forsage BUSD matrix built around activating slots, selling positions to new participants, and repeatedly buying them back. It instructs viewers to join a 10 BUSD process, sell the slot program to three people, and teach others to duplicate the same activity. It then presents the financial upside as 200% of slot value and a 560% benefit per cycle, alongside a one-week earnings example and directions toward the project domain. Although the presenter describes the program as investment-free, anti-scam, and transparent, the mechanics still connect participation and business-network payments to recruiting new members. The demonstrated slot and referral structure therefore supports the stated concern about recruitment commissions and tiered matrices without requiring a claim of guaranteed losses or a completed outcome.
